name: Spring Roll
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 5

Flavor Profiles umami, texture, bitter, temperature, texture
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 8 hours; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

A medley of vegetables are wrapped in a wonton wrapper and boiled or lightly pan fried to maintain the burst of senses that occurs when biting into one.

When consumed, it grants one of the following benefits, as the listed spell, for the duration. As a full-round action, you can change one of the benefits for another.

detect magic, detect secret doors, read magic, see alignment

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1, allow you to choose an additional benefit each, and add true seeing to the list of options.
